Well it plays a lot like Monster Hunter. Except, it's set on a sort of post-apocalyptic future era instead of the past. And another difference it has from Monster Hunte (on my PSP at least) is that it has target lock on while in melee mode, MH didn't. I played both Japanese and English versions of the first one and voice acting on both's pretty good. The English version replaced the opening with a dubstep remix of the original OP. Plus the story's interesting, I believe Monster Hunter didn't even have a narrative, you just go do missions. As for if it's worth $20, for me personally yeah, because I clocked a long time on that game. The developers of God Eater also believe that DLCs should be free so you got those too.
